User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores user settings and profile information.

photoUrl.description: Base64 encoded or URL reference of profile photo.

appUsername.description: Social-media style username for search and identity.

activeSessions.description: Map of sessionId to session details (device, browser, os, lastActive).

courtId.description: The institution ID this user belongs to.

legalUpdateSubscription.description: User's email subscription preferences for legal updates.

optIn.description: Whether the user opted-in for email notifications.

practiceAreas.description: List of preferred practice areas selected.

DossierAudit.title: Court Dossier Audit Record
DossierAudit.description: Stores the results of a court record audit for history and tracking.

SharedDraft.title: Shared Document Draft
SharedDraft.description: A document shared with a unique token for collaboration.

SharedFolder.title: Shared Folder
SharedFolder.description: A folder shared with a unique token for access.

sharedWith.description: List of user IDs granted access.

AnalyticsEvent.title: Real-Time Analytics Event
AnalyticsEvent.description: Live real-time stream of user actions, legal searches, document analyses, and visits.

userId.description: User UID who triggered the action.

actionType.description: Action performed (e.g. visit, explain_law, doc_analysis, cassation, translate).

details.description: Details about query or document analyzed.

FeedbackMessage.title: Feedback & User Message
FeedbackMessage.description: User opinions, feedback, suggestions, and legal consultation inquiries.

contactInfo.description: Sender phone, Telegram username, or contact handle.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

documentId.description: ID of the document being annotated.

rangeStart.description: Start position of the highlighted text.

rangeEnd.description: End position of the highlighted text.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when annotation was created.

TelegramLegalDocument.title: Harvested Telegram Legal Document
TelegramLegalDocument.description: Proclamations, regulations, directives, and court cassation decisions extracted from Telegram channels like @wakoyeb and indexed for platform retrieval.

id.description: Unique ID for the harvested legal document.

channelHandle.description: Telegram channel username or handle (e.g. wakoyeb).

channelTitle.description: Title of the Telegram source channel.

postUrl.description: Direct URL link to the original Telegram post.

referenceNumber.description: Extracted legal reference (e.g. Lakk. Galmee 214539, Labsii 242/2014).

category.description: Legal topic category (e.g. labor, property_land, civil_contract, family).

summary.description: Extracted trilingual summary of the legal enactment or ruling.

rawText.description: Original raw message text from Telegram.

keyArticles.description: List of referenced statutory articles extracted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when stored in Firestore.

ObjectionTemplate.title: Objection Template
ObjectionTemplate.description: Customizable legal objection templates grouped by category.

CourtSession.title: Courtroom Session (Dhaddacha)
CourtSession.description: Stores a complete courtroom session including logs, witnesses, and procedural state, categorized by court level.

KioskSession.title: Courtroom Kiosk Session
KioskSession.description: Stores live state, configuration, activity logs, and remote diagnostics for a courtroom kiosk.

lastScreenCapture.description: Base64 data URL of the last remote screenshot.

captureTrigger.description: Timestamp when a new capture is requested.

PaymentTransaction.title: Payment Transaction Record
PaymentTransaction.description: Records user payment transactions for subscription plans and credit purchases.

LegislationItem.title: Legislation Repository Record
LegislationItem.description: Statutory laws, proclamations, regulations, and directives repository.

Discussion.title: Discussion Thread
Discussion.description: Discussion comments on a document or folder.

targetId.description: ID of the folder or document being discussed.

meetingLink.description: Shared meeting link for real-time discussion.

participants.description: List of invited participants and their contact handles.

LegalQnA.title: Legal Q&A Repository Record
LegalQnA.description: Precedent-backed question and answer legal knowledge repository.

SocialLegalPost.title: Social Legal Post Record
SocialLegalPost.description: Legal awareness updates and commentary posts.

TestDoc.title: Connection Test Document
TestDoc.description: Test doc used for verifying Firestore server connectivity.

WebAuthnCredential.title: WebAuthn Biometric Credential
WebAuthnCredential.description: Stores WebAuthn biometric credentials for user authentication.

CourtInstitution.title: Court Judicial Institution
CourtInstitution.description: Stores authorized court institutions, jurisdictions, and institutional admin access info.

customCourtName.description: Display name overridden by institutional super-admin.

logoUrl.description: Base64 encoded logo image for the court.

CourtUser.title: Court Judicial Staff / Judge
CourtUser.description: Stores judges and court legal officers provisioned by an authorized institutional court admin.

courtId.description: The institution ID this staff belongs to.

CourtAccessRequest.title: Court Institutional Accession Request
CourtAccessRequest.description: Stores requests from judicial institutions seeking admin provisioning and onboarding.

SystemConfig.title: Global System Configuration
SystemConfig.description: Platform-wide system configuration settings managed exclusively by the owner.

AdminActivityLog.title: Administrative Action Audit Log
AdminActivityLog.description: Audit records of all administrative actions executed by system administrators.

AuditLogEntry.title: Administrative Audit Log Entry
AuditLogEntry.description: Stores detailed logs for administrative actions, bench assignments, and approvals.

VectorChunk.title: Vector Embedding Chunk
VectorChunk.description: Text chunk and its associated embedding vector for RAG.

AuthLog.title: Authentication Log
AuthLog.description: Logs of user and biometric authentication events.

CourtStaffRequest.title: Court Staff Request
CourtStaffRequest.description: Staff account provisioning requests for court personnel.

AirtimeRequest.title: Airtime Recharge Request
AirtimeRequest.description: User airtime and credit top-up requests.

VerificationToken.title: Email Verification Token
VerificationToken.description: Tokens for URL email verification and account activation.

AdminActivityLogArchived.title: Archived Admin Log
AdminActivityLogArchived.description: Archived administrator actions for historical compliance.

CaseDocket.title: Court Case Docket
CaseDocket.description: Judicial docket record, litigation lifecycle stages, and assignments.

CourtNotification.title: Court Notification
CourtNotification.description: Consolidated assignments and automated 24-hour hearing session alerts.

vector_chunks/{chunkId}.description: Storage for text chunks and embeddings for RAG.

users/{userId}.description: Collection of user profiles keyed by user ID.

users/{userId}/webauthn_credentials/{cre.description: Collection of WebAuthn credentials for user authentication.

payment_transactions/{txId}.description: Payment records and reconciliation audit logs.

courtroom_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Live state and control data for courtroom kiosks.

analytics_events/{eventId}.description: Real-time feed of user interactions and feature usage without page reload.

feedback_messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time user feedback, comments, reviews, and consultation inbox messages.

annotations/{annotationId}.description: Annotations made by users on legal documents.

telegram_legal_documents/{documentId}.description: Harvested legal proclamations, regulations, and cassation rulings from public Telegram channels stored for platform indexing and retrieval.

dossier_audits/{auditId}.description: Historical record of court dossier audits performed by users for daily tracking.

shared_drafts/{draftId}.description: Access-controlled legal document drafts for collaborative review and commenting.

discussions/{discussionId}.description: Discussion threads for documents and folders.

objection_templates/{templateId}.description: Customizable legal objection templates grouped by category.

legislation_repository/{docId}.description: Repository of regional and federal legal proclamations.

legal_qna_repository/{docId}.description: Repository of legal questions and verified answers.

social_legal_repository/{docId}.description: Repository of legal awareness and case commentary posts.

auth_logs/{logId}.description: Logs of WebAuthn biometric authentication attempts.

court_users/{userId}.description: Judges and court legal experts created by court admins.

admin_activity_logs/{logId}.description: Historical audit logs of administrative actions.

audit_logs/{logId}.description: Detailed audit trail of administrative actions including bench assignments.

airtime_requests/{requestId}.description: User airtime and credit top-up requests.

cases/{caseId}.description: Court cases, litigation lifecycle dockets, and hearing schedules.

court_notifications/{notifId}.description: Consolidated assignments and automated 24-hour hearing session push notifications.
